source.revision: March 2026 to include the 2025 hurricane season)

methodology.description: AOML detailed continental United States hurricane impact/landfall table normalized from its published HTML.

marker_notes.$: AOML marks the record low reliability.
marker_notes.#: Mexico landfall first; Texas hurricane-force winds affected the United States.
marker_notes.&: Direct landfall; strongest winds were offshore.
marker_notes.%: Maximum winds affected the coast before landfall.
marker_notes.*: Closest approach to the United States without a center landfall.

methodology.direct_landfall_rule: Rows marked * or # are retained but excluded from direct-landfall ground-truth scoring.
methodology.storm_id_rule: AL plus the two-digit storm number and four-digit calendar year, matching HURDAT2 identifiers.

inferred.scope_note: AOML's 1983-1990 reference rows are hurricane-strength continental impacts; tropical-storm inferred candidates are reported but not scored as hurricane matches.
